assessments.reasoning:
For de_jure_vs_de_facto: True. Section 1 records sex (Q2), relationship to household head (Q5, including code 1 for head and code 2 for spouse/partner), and marital status (Q16: soltera, casada, conviviente, separada, divorciada, viuda). Combining information on female household heads (Q2=2, Q5=1) with marital status (Q16) and partner presence/absence in the household roster (presence of code 2) permits distinguishing de jure female heads (unpartnered: single, separated, divorced, widowed) from de facto female heads (married/cohabiting head whose spouse/partner is absent from the household).

For unpartnered_mother_child_units: False. Question 5 records relationships strictly relative to the household head ('¿Qué parentesco tiene con la jefa o jefe del hogar?'). The questionnaire lacks maternal line/mother ID pointers to link children directly to their mothers when residing as sub-units inside larger households.

For women_maintained_by_provider: False. Although individual labor income is captured in Section 2 (Q37, Q38), non-labor incomes (pensions, remittances, social transfers) are not captured in this instrument, nor is there a question establishing the main economic provider of the household or sub-household unit.

For mother_child_unit_activity: False. The instrument contains no questions linking mother-child sub-units to their own consumption, production, or care activities.
